annotation.title_clean: Understanding the Importance and Challenges of Animatronic Humanoid Prototypes Production in the Robotic Field in the United of States of America: Policy Implications
annotation.title_en: Understanding the Importance and Challenges of Animatronic Humanoid Prototypes Production in the Robotic Field in the United of States of America: Policy Implications
annotation.summary_en: Narrative literature review of 22 articles on animatronic humanoid robot production, covering achievements (biped locomotion, learning) and challenges (complex environments, perception, human-robot interaction). It recommends that investors, policymakers and officials invest more in robotic production to boost productivity, with little regulatory content.
key_provisions_or_claims: 22% of reviewed articles cite biped locomotion as a humanoid achievement; 18% cite learning capabilities.
Key challenges: complex environments, perception, human-robot interaction, real-life collaboration.
Designers should rethink materials and use morphological computation.
Policymakers and investors should invest more in robotic production to raise productivity.
Method: narrative review using Boolean search.
